method: Read under subscription in the operator's browser and PARAPHRASED. No AMH passage reproduced and no source_text stored; every claim carries a locator and verdict licensed_source_not_quoted. Application-time and repeat-interval claims are flagged dose:true because they ARE the dose for these products. No oral ivermectin dose is given for head lice in the source; the scabies ivermectin dose held in the ectoparasites guideline was deliberately NOT carried across to this indication.
